away.summary: No specific lineup or injury information for the Columbus Blue Jackets was provided in the articles ahead of their October 10 game against the St. Louis Blues. The available content focused on future promotional events (Jackets Jukebox series starting October 17) and unrelated Sharks/Blues games from October 8-9.

returning: : Justin Barron is expected to make his Blues debut on Thursday. He'll go in for Theo Lindstein to partner Colton Parayko.
home.summary: The St. Louis Blues are projected to start Joel Hofer in goal against the Columbus Blue Jackets. The team will welcome Justin Barron into the lineup for his Blues debut, replacing Theo Lindstein as a healthy scratch. Defensemen Alexey Toropchenko (upper body), Tyler Tucker (knee), and Logan Mailloux (hand) are injured and out, while Zach Dean is also scratched.
